summary: April 28-29 FOMC held rates steady at 3.5%-3.75%. Median projection: 1 rate cut in 2026. Unusual 8-4 dissent (most dissents since Oct 1992). Oil spike from Iran war complicates inflation picture. Powell remains on board.
